title: Capability Lifecycle Event v1
description: Host-controlled lifecycle governance evidence recording append-only post-admission status transitions for capability instances. Confers zero execution permission or authority revival.

schema_version.description: Semantic type identity. Distinct from compilation, admission, and capability schemas.

capability_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this lifecycle event to the specific CapabilityPayloadV1 instance.

admission_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this lifecycle event to the upstream CAPABILITY_ADMISSION_RESULT-v1 instance.

compilation_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this lifecycle event to the upstream CAPABILITY_COMPILATION_RESULT-v1 instance.

evaluation_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this lifecycle event to the upstream EFFECT_EVALUATION_RESULT-v1 instance.

proposal_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this lifecycle event to the original source EFFECT_PROPOSAL-v1 instance.

event_type.description: Governed classification of the lifecycle operational event.

event_timestamp.description: Deterministic ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lifecycle transition occurred.

new_state.description: Post-transition capability state enforcing monotonic progression.

authority_reference.description: Identifier of the host-controlled lifecycle controller or supervisor recording the event.
